papers.summaryEn: This paper combines vision and wrist force/torque records in a coding agent that generates contact-probing and force-feedback control programs. Between real robot runs, the agent analyzes failures and revises its code. Across five real-world manipulation tasks, the authors report improvements over an otherwise similar vision-only agent in grasping, adapting to object or surface changes, and maintaining contact during wiping and peeling. No task demonstrations or task-specific training are required, but the system still relies on predefined skills and a particular sensor setup.

papers.summaryEn: For small robots with limited compute and memory, RingNav constrains heading memory to a circular manifold instead of storing a general hidden state. It learns the rotation between consecutive images and accumulates heading geometrically. The authors report lower rotation and short-horizon accumulated errors on visual benchmarks, together with transfer to a real drone without fine-tuning. Reported operation on a Raspberry Pi and a low-power processor also makes it relevant to embedded perception.

papers.summaryEn: A-SLS incorporates the uncertainty reduction expected from future parameter identification into robust adaptive model predictive control. By retaining correlations among disturbances, parameter errors, and estimator updates, it aims to reduce the conservatism of reachable tubes. The authors accelerate optimization on a GPU and report examples involving nonlinear robotic systems, higher-dimensional quadruped whole-body control, and online identification on a real Crazyflie. The central idea is to consider safety constraints, active learning, and real-time computation together rather than focusing only on tracking error.

papers.summaryEn: For robot teams with potentially attacked communication links, this paper adds a trust-filtering layer around existing collaboration algorithms. Continuous trust scores from an anomaly detector feed anytime-valid statistical inference, allowing compromised links to be excluded with high probability over time while healthy links are gradually accepted. The authors demonstrate neural implicit mapping and heading-consensus tasks on real robots, and study larger teams in simulation using hardware-sampled trust scores.

papers.summaryEn: PlayPolicy first learns a behavior policy from a small amount of human play. The robot then collects additional contact data autonomously to train a world model. During task execution, the policy proposes actions for model predictive control to select, and the resulting behavior can be distilled into a fast closed-loop policy. The authors report data-efficiency benefits on pushing and in-hand reorientation. The approach connects data collection, planning proposals, and policy learning, although its abilities remain limited by the coverage of the initial play data.

papers.title: 以运动学约束为参照的铰接物体操作评估
papers.titleEn: Kinematic Constraint-Referenced Evaluation for Articulated Object Manipulation
papers.summary: 论文指出二元任务成功率难以揭示操作动作是否符合物体关节约束，提出把末端运动投影到关节轴，分离有效进展与偏离约束的浪费。作者在多种仿真铰接物体上展示，这类指标能够区分成功率掩盖的迁移失效，并分析关节轴估计误差的影响。方法无需学习评判器，但需要关节模型及由其构建的参考控制器。

papers.summaryEn: Binary success rates can hide whether a robot’s motion respects an object’s joint constraints. This paper projects end-effector motion onto the joint axis to separate useful progress from motion that departs from the constraint. Across simulated articulated objects, the authors show that these metrics can distinguish transfer failures obscured by success rates and examine sensitivity to joint-axis estimation error. No learned evaluator is required, but the method needs a joint model and a reference controller built from it.

papers.summaryEn: The authors build seven long-horizon household task types in Habitat, varying the robot’s initial memory and environment configuration while comparing three planning approaches in a shared execution framework. Beyond success, the evaluation measures partial completion and action efficiency, and diagnoses placement, precondition, and redundant-action errors in execution traces. The results suggest that accurate initial memory does not consistently improve every planner, raising questions about how embodied agents use knowledge and handle uncertainty during execution.

papers.summary: 视图中删掉一个结果，可能误删共享源数据支持的其他结果。本文把源端代价、视图副作用与最小见证等任务统一成广义删除传播，用整数规划表达必须删除／保留的结果及优化目标，再以平滑约束改善求解。它覆盖已知可解特例，并支持自连接、并与袋语义；但“所有可解情形都只需整数规划”仍是猜想，不能解读为一般问题均为多项式时间。

papers.summaryEn: Deleting one view result may unintentionally remove other results supported by shared source data. This paper unifies source-side cost, view side effects, and minimum-witness tasks as generalized deletion propagation. An integer program expresses results that must be deleted or retained and the optimization objective, with smoothing constraints improving solving behavior. The framework covers known tractable cases and supports self-joins, unions, and bag semantics. However, the claim that integer programming suffices for every tractable case remains a conjecture; it does not make the general problem polynomial-time.

papers.title: 寻找缺失答案修复的复杂性
papers.titleEn: The Complexity of Finding Missing Answer Repairs
papers.summary: 如何最少修改源数据，让一个缺失查询答案出现？本文允许插入与删除，区分修复存在性、大小与构造问题，并系统比较组合复杂度和数据复杂度。查询也作为输入时，投影与连接可带来集合覆盖级困难；但固定查询后，半正Datalog的最小修复可多项式求得。关键提醒是：这里最小化源端修改数，并不保证其他视图答案不变，更不自动满足VKG本体约束。
papers.whySelected: 适合界定VKG插入/修改分支的理论边界：固定本体和映射后应优先讨论数据复杂度，不能直接用组合复杂度下界否定实现可能性。

papers.summaryEn: What is the smallest source-data change that makes a missing query answer appear? This paper permits insertions and deletions, separates repair existence, size, and construction, and compares combined complexity with data complexity. When the query is also input, projection and joins can introduce set-cover-level difficulty. For a fixed semipositive Datalog query, however, a minimum repair can be found in polynomial time. The objective minimizes source edits: it neither guarantees that other view answers remain unchanged nor automatically enforces a VKG ontology.

papers.summaryEn: Must robot action learning use diffusion models? Starting from familiar mean squared error, this paper observes that demonstration prediction errors vary with state, so a few large errors can dominate training. The authors use a Student-t loss that accommodates heavy-tailed errors and additionally predict the error scale, bringing single-forward-pass regression policies closer to generative-policy performance. Start with the project illustrations, then Sections 3–4. Focus on how the loss allocates learning attention rather than trying to derive every probability formula immediately.

papers.title: 何时、何处、如何纠正：人类引导的机器人策略自适应残差修正
papers.titleEn: When, Where, and What to Correct: Human-Guided Adaptive Residual Correction for Robot Policies
papers.summary: 如果模仿学习已能完成大半段动作，只在插入或摆放时差一点，是否必须重训整个策略？ARC 保持原策略不变，把少量人工纠正拆成三件事：判断何时介入、限定向哪些方向微调，再用奖励学习具体修正量。三项实机任务的平均成功率从33.3%到75%，但每方法每任务仅12次测试。先看流程图，再读实验设置，学会区分“人给探索线索”和“直接模仿人的动作”。
papers.whySelected: 把 BC→残差 RL 的衔接讲得直观，适合建立真实机器人后训练的基本图景；同时可练习阅读成功率背后的测试数量。

prerequisites: 行为克隆与ACT的基本概念
强化学习中的状态、动作、奖励
残差＝在原动作上加小修正

limits: 仅3项实机任务，每方法每任务12次；早期小规模证据。
依赖任务及操作者相关的纠正时机，门控可能随操作者变化。
用于已有基本能力策略的局部修正，不代表能从零学习复杂操作。

papers.summaryEn: If an imitation policy already performs most of a motion but narrowly misses an insertion or placement, must the whole policy be retrained? ARC keeps the base policy fixed and separates a few human corrections into when to intervene, which directions to adjust, and how much correction to learn through rewards. Across three real-world tasks, mean success rises from 33.3% to 75%, with only 12 tests per method per task. Read the workflow before the experimental setup, distinguishing human-provided exploration guidance from directly imitating human actions.
